ADC_PARAMETER Body

Package to handle parameter values. There are two main tasks to perform:

  • Validate any parameter upon creation or changing of the rule action

  • Evaluate the parameter value upon execution

Author

Juergen Sieben, ConDeS GmbH

parse
procedure parse(
p_stmt 
in varchar2,
p_column_count 
in binary_integer
 default 
null,
p_column_type_check 
in number_table
 default 
null
)

Method to parse a statement and throw and exception if parsing fails.

Parameter
p_stmt
in varchar2

Statement to parse.

p_column_count
in binary_integer

Optional column count check

p_column_type_check
in number_table

Number table with a list of number paiers in the logical form <column_index>, <column_data_type>

Throws
ADC_INVALID_SQL

if parsing fails

ADC_INVALID_COLUMN_COUNT

If a column count check was ordered and failed

ADC_INVALID_COLUMN_TYPE

If a list of column indexes and data types was provided and the data type does not match
